subject: Unmatched remittance from Northstar — action plan to move cash & correct ledger
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: Unmatched remittance from Northstar — action plan to move cash & correct ledger

Team —

Quick heads up: we received a £72,450 remittance from Northstar (bank trace attached) that was applied to the EMEA reseller entity by AP, but the original invoice (INV-55923) should be recognized by the US product entity. The payment is sitting against Redwood EMEA unapplied cash (GL 11130) and the AR balance on the US entity still shows open — causing an AR aging mismatch for September close.

Snapshot attached: northstar_unapplied_20260914.csv (bank reference + allocation). I think the right path is:
- Create a reversing application in AR to remove the payment from EMEA application.
- Post JV to move the cash from EMEA bank clearing (GL 11130) to US bank clearing (GL 11110) with appropriate intercompany memo.
- Update revenue mapping for INV-55923 so revenue recognizes to the US pool (revpool-us-prod) and not revpool-emea-reseller.

Questions / asks:
- Laura: can you validate if VAT was withheld on the payment (Northstar is UK-based) and whether we need to treat part of the remittance as VAT?
- Grace: can you draft the AR reversal steps and timeline so Collections can action?
- Marcus: need your JE template and confirmation on account codes + disclosure for the move (will this need a consolidation reclass at month-end?).

Target to have a posting plan and JE draft by end of week so we don't roll bad balances into month-end. I attached the CSV and a quick note on the invoice.

Thanks —
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Head of Customer Finance Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: northstar_unapplied_20260914.csv

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Unmatched remittance from Northstar — action plan to move cash & correct ledger

Jonas — thanks for flagging. I pulled the CSV and bank trace. A couple of quick notes:

1) The payment reference contains "RD-EU-004" which is our EMEA remit code — looks like Northstar used the reseller remit reference by mistake.
2) The originating payment currency is GBP and Northstar's remittance line shows an amount that looks gross (no explicit VAT breakdown). We'll need a copy of the remittance PDF from the customer bank to confirm VAT treatment.

Proposed immediate actions:
- Collections (Grace) to create a reversing application in Zuora/FinanceOps to unapply the payment from the EMEA invoice and place it in unapplied cash. (Grace: please include a note in the application that the customer confirmed this was for INV-55923.)
- Once unapplied, we can post JE to move cash across entities. I attached the AR-JV-template.xlsx — please use the template for JE line detail and include intercompany reference.

Timeline: if we can get the remittance PDF from the customer by Thursday morning, I can prepare the JE draft and queue it for review Friday. If VAT is present, we will need Marcus to confirm the VAT posting and any reclaim or accrual.

I'll own the JE prep once I have the remittance.

Laura Bennett
Finance Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: AR-JV-template.xlsx

From: Marta Vega <marta.vega@northstar.cloud>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: payments@northstar.cloud
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2026 08:44:12 +0100
Subject: Re: Payment remittance for INV-55923 (bank trace attached)

Hi Jonas —

Thanks for the ping. Confirming payment details from Northstar AP: the transfer was initiated 2026-09-10 (GBP) for invoice INV-55923. Bank reference included: "RD-EU-004 / INV-55923". We apologize — AP used the reseller remit code in the reference field.

Attached is the remittance advice PDF (northstar_remit_INV55923.pdf) showing the single line: 60,375.00 GBP (net) + 12,075.00 GBP (VAT) = 72,450.00 GBP. VAT was included on our side and shown separately on the remittance.

Please confirm how you'd like us to proceed on our end — we can resubmit with corrected remit code if that helps with auto-application, but we understand you may prefer an internal JE to move cash.

Regards,
Marta Vega
AP Manager
Northstar Cloud

Attachments: northstar_remit_INV55923.pdf

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Unmatched remittance from Northstar — action plan to move cash & correct ledger

All — good catch and thanks Marta for the confirmation. Based on the remittance, VAT was explicitly included (12,075 GBP). Proposed accounting approach below — please review and call out concerns before I post the draft JE:

Planned journal (JE-20260922-ARMOVE) — draft lines:
1) Debit GL 11130 (EMEA bank clearing) 72,450.00 GBP — reverse cash that was misapplied
2) Credit AR application (EMEA) 72,450.00 GBP — reverse the application to put cash back into unapplied balance
3) Debit AR (US invoice INV-55923) 60,375.00 GBP — apply net amount to US AR (reduces US invoice balance)
4) Debit VAT payable (UK) 12,075.00 GBP — record VAT liability in EMEA that was part of the remittance
5) Credit GL 11110 (US bank clearing) 72,450.00 GBP — move cash into US bank account via intercompany clearing
6) Intercompany memo: "Move cash for INV-55923 — Northstar; reclass EMEA -> US; JE 20260922-ARMOVE"

Notes:
- We'll record the VAT liability in the EMEA statutory books (GL VAT-UK-2100) and coordinate with Tax to either remit or reclaim depending on filings. This avoids overstating US revenue for VAT amounts.
- For consolidation: the intercompany balances will net in consolidation; I'll mark this JE as reclass to be reviewed by consolidation team.
- I'll attach the csv with the JE lines: JE-20260922-draft.csv. Laura — please use the AR-JV-template.xlsx to move these to your upload format.

Owners / ETA:
- Grace: execute the reversing application in Zuora today (ETA EOD).
- Laura: prepare JE upload file by Thursday morning and send to me for review.
- Marcus: I will run a post-JE check on Friday to confirm AR and bank clearing balances align.

If we stay on this timetable, we should close the loop before month-end and avoid misstated AR aging for both EMEA and US.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Revenue Accounting Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: JE-20260922-draft.csv
